params.default: Put the client's books next to 26AS, AIS and TIS in {product}, and clear every difference before review.
params.label: The cover's opening line; {product} = this edition's name

params.name: icon
params.label: The emblem on the cover (an icon name)

params.name: steps

default.title: Portal files
default.say: Upload the 26AS text export from TRACES, and AIS or TIS as CSV or Excel. Each file says what it is and how many entries were read.

default.title: Findings
default.say: Red first: TDS the books claim that 26AS does not show, income the portal reports beyond the books, tax paid that does not match. Amber needs a look; green agrees.

default.title: Only mapped rows count
default.say: From the books, only rows whose SF Ref is saved or came with the file are counted. Accept the suggestions in Intake & map first.

default.title: Explain or fix
default.say: Fix the statement and upload it again, or press Explain and write why it is fine. A year cannot move to Review while a red finding has no explanation.

params.label: The steps in order: title, say (the narration), target (where the spotlight goes; alternatives split by |, the first on screen wins), art (the picture: hero/flow/roads/meter/stack/check), place (below/above/right/left/center, optional), open (optional: what the guide presses first when the part is not on screen - open the first item, go back Home; alternatives split by |)
